concerns.text: T018-Sens (Sensitivity Interpolation) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) and depends only on T018-Locl. However, the task description implies it modifies the same `preprocess.py` file or shares the same data context as T018-Locl. If T018-Sens runs in parallel with T018-Locl, it risks overwriting the primary linear interpolation logic or reading incomplete state. Parallel tasks modifying the same file or shared data context without explicit isolation are not parallel-safe.

T027b (Bonferroni Correction) is marked complete and depends on T027. T039 (Holm-Bonferroni Correction) is a revision task marked uncompleted but depends on T027. The plan mandates Holm-Bonferroni (Plan: Phase 2, Complexity Tracking). T027b implements simple Bonferroni. The task order implies T027b is the 'final' implementation, but the plan requires T039. This creates a semantic violation where the 'consumer' (T027b) is implemented before the 'producer' (T039) of the correct statistical method, violating the plan's dependency on Holm-Bonferroni.

T040 (Cointegration Check) is a revision task marked uncompleted, depending on T019a (ADF & Differencing). The Plan (Phase 1) explicitly requires Cointegration Check *before* deciding between ECM or differenced Granger tests. T019a implements differencing logic assuming non-cointegration. The current order executes T019a (differencing) before T040 (cointegration check), violating the data-flow dependency where the cointegration result must determine the preprocessing path.

FR-001 requires the final report to explicitly note 'social media amplification' as a confounding variable. T012b (Raw Data Documentation) creates a README with this text. T030-TEXT (Constants) creates `code/constants.py` with the text. T030-ASSEMBLE (PDF) depends on T030-TEXT. However, T012b is a documentation task, not a code artifact. The dependency chain for the *report* relies on T030-TEXT. If T030-TEXT does not explicitly include the 'confounding variable' text (only T012b does), the final report (T030-ASSEMBLE) will miss the FR-001 requirement. The task order assumes T030-TEXT covers FR-001 fully, but the text is currently only in T012b (README) and T030-TEXT (Constants) needs verification to ensure it contains the full FR-001 string.
